title: The Perfect Chairs For a Small Area
text: The Perfect Chairs For a Small Area. I got these chairs for the bar in my new kitchen. They were exactly what I saw in my mind. The quality is about what you've come to expect from China for this amount of money. I expect they may last about a year with daily use. Assembly was easily accomplished with one person. They are attractive but a bit wobbly because I think  one of the bases was a little out of round. Overall a very cheaply made product, but it will suffice since there really aren't any other options.
